about: Ferro-Gradumet (ferrous sulfate 325 mg) is supplied monthly with directions of two tablets a day, which is 650 mg of ferrous sulfate a day (about 210 mg of iron), by brand name only.

Ferrous sulfate 325 mg is supplied three times from January to March 2026, in the middle of a 16-month history, with directions of one tablet three times a day, which is 975 mg of ferrous sulfate a day (about 315 mg of iron).
Maltofer (iron polymaltose) is supplied with directions of two 100 mg tablets a day, which is exactly 200 mg of iron a day and not more than 200 mg, so there is no finding.
